==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{root|ru|ine-pro|*steh₂-}}
{{inh+|ru|orv|ставити}}, from {{inh|ru|sla-pro|*staviti||to place, put}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|ста́вить}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-ставить.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|ста́вить|impf|pf=поста́вить}}

# to [[put]], to [[place]], to [[set]], to [[stand]], to [[station]]
# ''(a compress)'' to [[apply]], to [[put on]]
# ''(a play)'' to put on [[stage]], to [[stage]], to [[produce]], to [[present]]
# {{lb|ru|gambling}} to [[wager]], to [[place]] a bet, to [[stake]]
# ''(a question)'' to [[raise]], to [[put]]

==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{af|ru|писа́ть|-аный}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|пи́саный}}

===Adjective===
{{ru-adj|пи́саный}}

# {{lb|ru|colloquial}} [[write down|written down]], [[fixed]] in [[writing]]
#: {{uxi|ru|'''пи́саная''' [[были́на]]|written-down [[bylina]] {{q|type of East Slavic oral epic}}}}
# {{lb|ru|colloquial}} [[handwritten]]
# [[written]] in [[color]], [[decorate]]d
# {{lb|ru|colloquial}} [[very]] [[beautiful]], as if [[paint]]ed or [[decorate]]d
# [[paint]]ed

====Usage notes====
Short forms {{lang|ru|пи́сан, пи́сана, пи́сано, пи́саны}} theoretically exist, but are usually avoided, as they are the same as the short forms of the past passive participle of {{m|ru|писа́ть||to write}}.
